title: [V1] Isolate native media jobs with per-job filesystem and resource limits
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V1).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Run each native decoder job with no network access, bounded CPU/memory/process/file-size/disk use, and a per-job mount containing only its authorized media.
- [ ] Preserve durable job cancellation, retry and lease-owner fencing across the isolated worker boundary.
- [ ] Test malicious-media fixtures cannot access another source or exhaust host resources; exercise timeout/cancellation and cleanup.

title: [V2] Add resumable S3-compatible direct uploads
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V2).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Add an S3/R2 storage adapter and short-lived, workspace-scoped direct-upload authorization with resumable transfer.
- [ ] Finalize a source only after size/checksum validation and provenance/attestation persistence; keep original masters immutable.
- [ ] Test interruption/resume on a large fixture, checksum mismatch, cross-workspace access and expired signatures.

title: [V3] Add pluggable timestamped transcription with a local default
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V3).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Persist timestamped transcription through a provider interface; default to a local provider and never enable paid usage implicitly.
- [ ] Align delayed and segmented audio to source time and record provider latency/cost metadata.
- [ ] Test synthetic delayed/segmented audio alignment, provider failure/retry and structured untrusted transcript handling.

title: [V4] Evaluate VAD and shortlisted semantic ranking against the baseline
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V4).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Add modular VAD/speech activity and scene signals, preserving individual component scores.
- [ ] Apply optional semantic reranking only to shortlisted candidates with strict input/output schemas; treat media text as untrusted content.
- [ ] Evaluate labelled precision@5 against the deterministic baseline and enable the new ranker only after measurable improvement; include malformed output and prompt-injection fixtures.

title: [V5] Extend edit plans with templates, tracked crops, overlays and audio stems
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V5).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Add saved templates, keyframed gameplay crops/tracked facecam, plain-text overlays and separated microphone/game stem selection.
- [ ] Keep edits versioned and declarative, preserve source masters, and invalidate approval after material edit changes.
- [ ] Add golden/structural media tests for transforms, timing, overlay placement and stem selection/muting.

title: [V6] Add per-span content-risk signals without granting rights clearance
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V6).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Persist and display per-span spoiler, music and third-party content risk signals for creator review.
- [ ] Keep detection separate from authorization and legal clearance; unknown states remain explicit.
- [ ] Regression-test embargo locks, exact-revision approval and export gates, including misleading/absent detector signals.

title: [V7] Add account recovery, export/deletion and workspace roles
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (V7).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Implement verified email, password reset, account export/deletion, workspace roles and invitations.
- [ ] Audit downstream deletion jobs and enforce permissions consistently across sources, derivatives and workflow actions.
- [ ] Test cross-role/cross-tenant access, token expiry/replay, recovery flows and retryable downstream deletion.

title: [P1] Ingest authorized Twitch broadcaster/editor media through official APIs
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P1).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Use documented Twitch APIs with broadcaster/editor authorization and least-privilege scopes; persist source provenance.
- [ ] Reject media outside the connected user's authorization; do not add playback scraping, cookie extraction or undocumented downloads.
- [ ] Add mocked/sandbox tests for scope checks, unauthorized sources, provider errors and tenant isolation.

title: [P2] Persist publication lifecycle and exact approval provenance
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P2).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Persist provider-neutral Publication, PlatformAccount and Connection records with source → rights assessment → edit → human approval → account provenance.
- [ ] Make publication idempotent and retain external request/post identifiers; distinguish safe retry from ambiguous outcomes requiring manual reconciliation.
- [ ] Test duplicate jobs, stale approvals, concurrent retries, ambiguous provider failures and cross-workspace account access without making real posts.

title: [P3] Implement one official Buffer or YouTube publishing adapter
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P3).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Implement one documented Buffer or YouTube provider chosen from configured project priorities, using encrypted credentials and least-privilege scopes.
- [ ] Preserve the provider-neutral approval/idempotency contract; require explicit creator confirmation for any real publication.
- [ ] Use sandbox/dry-run integration tests for token handling, rate limits, retry outcomes and request identifiers; tests must not publish publicly.

title: [P4] Add TikTok draft and creator-consent workflow
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P4).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Show creator visibility, caption and consent controls and support draft/confirmation-first delivery.
- [ ] Respect documented audit/private-client restrictions, scopes and posting/rate limits.
- [ ] Test consent gating, restricted/unaudited-client behavior, rate-limit responses and retry safety through mocks or sandbox; no real social posts.

title: [P5] Synchronize provider metrics without inventing unavailable values
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P5).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Persist MetricSnapshot records using only documented provider capabilities and available permissions.
- [ ] Deduplicate sync requests/identifiers and represent unavailable watch-time or engagement metrics distinctly from zero.
- [ ] Test repeated/out-of-order sync, unsupported metric fields, provider rate limits and cross-account/tenant isolation.

title: [P6] Verify signed webhooks and support OAuth rotation/revocation
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P6).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Validate webhook signatures and freshness/replay protections before processing events.
- [ ] Implement credential rotation/revocation and account-bound OAuth callback validation with least-privilege scope handling.
- [ ] Test forged/replayed webhooks, cross-account callbacks, revoked credentials and token rotation without exposing secrets.

title: [P7] Import creator-owned storage exports and watched-folder uploads
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (P7).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Add authorized creator-owned storage exports and a local watched-folder uploader with short-lived, scoped credentials.
- [ ] Persist authorization/provenance for every imported recording and preserve checksum validation and workspace boundaries.
- [ ] Test SSRF/redirect protections for import paths, unauthorized objects, credential expiry and provenance persistence.

title: [O1] Add explicit usage-based plans, quotas and signed billing webhooks
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O1).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Implement explicit usage-based plans and enforce documented workspace quotas.
- [ ] Verify signed billing webhooks and make entitlement changes idempotent; do not imply unlimited allowances or initiate paid purchases automatically.
- [ ] Use test-mode/mocked billing to cover signature rejection, duplicate/out-of-order events and quota enforcement; no real charges.

title: [O2] Add authorized chat signals and evaluated game detector plugins
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O2).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Add authorized chat-spike signals, a detector plugin interface and game-specific packs derived from real labelled examples.
- [ ] Keep core ranking game-agnostic and preserve component scores and creator feedback provenance.
- [ ] Evaluate accepted-at-k, duplicate rate, boundary quality, processing latency and cost/source-hour; test unauthorized chat rejection and plugin failures.

title: [O3] Validate creator-personalized ranking using sufficient labelled data
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O3).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Define sufficient labelled-data criteria before introducing creator-personalized ranking.
- [ ] Use creator acceptance/rejection/edit history with strict workspace boundaries and a deterministic fallback.
- [ ] Demonstrate improvement over the baseline in the offline evaluation suite; test sparse-history fallback and cross-creator/tenant isolation.

title: [O4] Add workflow observability and test operational recovery
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O4).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Propagate correlation IDs and expose queue/stage latency dashboards, quota alerts and storage/deletion observability.
- [ ] Document and exercise backup restore and application rollback against disposable environments.
- [ ] Test telemetry for failures/retries/cleanup, secret-safe logging, alert thresholds and successful restore/rollback drills.

title: [O5] Replace legal drafts with operator-reviewed privacy, terms and DMCA procedures
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O5).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Obtain operator/human review of privacy, terms, DMCA/takedown procedures and relevant commercial gameplay rights.
- [ ] Replace operational drafts before public launch and define responsibilities for notices, removals and repeat infringement.
- [ ] Review documentation against implemented retention/deletion and publication behavior; record unresolved rights issues explicitly rather than implying clearance.

title: [O6] Add scoped API keys, public API and signed webhooks
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O6).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Expose the supported public API behind scoped, revocable API keys, workspace-aware rate limits and signed outgoing webhooks.
- [ ] Keep credentials secret and enforce the same tenant/approval boundaries as interactive sessions.
- [ ] Test cross-tenant access, scope restrictions, key revocation, webhook signature verification and rate-limit behavior.

title: [O7] Configure supported repository security checks and SBOM/license reporting
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O7).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Generate an SBOM and license-compliance report, and configure supported host-side CodeQL, secret scanning, rulesets and required checks.
- [ ] Confirm actual repository/account eligibility before enabling paid or unavailable features; distinguish workflow files from remotely enabled settings.
- [ ] Validate generated reports and configured checks, and record actual enabled settings and any account-dependent gaps.

title: [O8] Preserve immutable rights-assessment snapshots for publication history
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O8).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Persist an immutable assessment snapshot for each rights revision before publication-history work relies on historical approvals.
- [ ] Reference the exact snapshot from review/publication provenance and preserve the current rights-update invalidation rules.
- [ ] Test that later assessment changes cannot alter prior snapshots and that historical approval provenance remains reconstructable and tenant-isolated.

title: [O9] Display configured upload and retention limits in the studio
body:
Planned future work from `docs/backlog.md` (O9).

Acceptance criteria and checks:

- [ ] Expose safe runtime upload-size and raw-retention settings to the authenticated UI.
- [ ] Replace hard-coded default-only upload/retention text with the active configured values.
